title: Error response
description: A request that failed. The data is troupe's structured error, so every surface can render it.

id.description: The failed request's id, or null when the request could not be read.

code.description: JSON-RPC error code: the standard values (-32700 to -32600), or -32000 when the runner refuses a valid request.

data.description: One of the contract's own errors (errors.schema.json), or one of the runner's own codes, which the runner publishes and which fill the runnerErrors extension point.

runnerErrors.title: The runner's own errors
runnerErrors.description: An extension point: a runner's published errors schema fills it. Without one, no code beyond the contract's validates.
